properties.description:

in the vicinity of Commonwealth Road, Glebe Road, and Wilson Avenue
with multiple vehicles stalled out in high water. Between 1 and 2
inches of rain have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1 to 2
inches in 30 minutes. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch
are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is already occurring.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Emergency management reported.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Arlington, Alexandria, Annandale, Springfield, Vienna, Groveton,
Falls Church, Huntington, Mantua, Pimmit Hills, Crystal City,
Reagan National Airport, Burke, Lincolnia, Tysons Corner,
Franconia, Merrifield, Lake Barcroft, I395 and I495 Interchange and
Ballston.
